When it comes to the realm of fashion, my favourite brands are the ones that make me feel like I’ve stepped into a magical mythical fairytale… like Selkie dresses!

And today I’m here to share my Selkie discount code: KELLYPW for November AND my Selkie discount code KELLYPW for December to help your magical fashion dreams become reality too. 🙂

Perfect timing for a little extra Selkie discount this winter for your wardrobe!

I love brands that stand out not just for their style but for the magical stories they weave into their designs. Over the last few years Selkie has become one of my favourite brands.

They are known for their ethereal designs inspired by folklore and fantasy. They feel SO magical! And I can’t get enough!

I remember when they first launched and I was absolutely enamoured by their designs. The puff dresses felt like the perfect way to play dress up as an adult.

This brand has really helped me grow into my style and fall deeper in love with whimsical fashion. And discovering fashion that just feels fun everyday.

Since their launch, I’ve continued to order their newer designs and styles too. From their classic puff dresses through to stunning maxi dress gowns (I can’t seem to resist a good ball gown).

Admittedly, my wardrobe is kind of overflowing at this point. But I do think it’s worth it – playing dress up like this in real life has totally changed my outlook on how fun fashion can feel.

And I’m not here to gate keep on discounts and savings! So if you’re interested… here’s your magical discount code to use when shopping at Selkie.

Selkie discount code: KELLYPW

I’ll cut right to the chase – here is my Selkie discount code.

This Selkie influencer code below will give you 10% off your first order!

Use the code: KELLYPW

PS It also works on any additional email addresses that you have as well.

So if you’ve used the code before but have another email on hand… well, it’s worth using across all of them for each new order you may place.

…Or at least that’s what I’ve done!

Behind the dress:

A little behind the brand… In case you didn’t know, Selkies are mythical creatures from Celtic folklore and are said to possess shapeshifting abilities to transform from seals into humans.

Selkie, the fashion brand, draws inspiration from this magical mythology, creating designs that seamlessly blend the mystical and whimsical into a modern style you can wear everyday.

Or at least I do because life certainly feels a bit more fun when you’re able to wear a gown for everyday life!

From flowing maxi dresses reminiscent of ocean waves to whimsical prints and super cute puff dresses (like my fave classic black puff dress) – each Selkie Dress is a wearable work of art that tells a story.

And the compliments I get in them – SO GOOD!

How to use the November Selkie discount code ‘KELLYPW’:

To share the magic with fellow fashion enthusiasts, I’m sharing my brilliant Selkie voucher code to share with you.

Time to unlock a world of savings – yay!

The Selkie discount code, “KELLYPW,” grants a 10% reduction on all Selkie collections.

So you can experience the allure of these captivating designs with a little bit of saving too.

Using the code is as easy as casting a spell.

Follow these simple steps on how to save with this November Selkie Discount Code + December Selkie Discount Code:

  1. Visit the Selkie website and explore their mesmerising collections.
  2. Choose your favourite Selkie items and add them to your cart.
  3. During the checkout process, enter the Selkie influencer discount code “KELLYPW” in the designated field before paying.
  4. You’ll immediately reveal a 10% discount on your selected items (and it feels so good!)
  5. Complete your purchase and await the arrival of your magical garments.
  6. PS using ANY link I share here to the website should automatically add the discount too.
  7. Also it only works for ONE email address… but if you have multiple emails (like I do!) you can use it a few times with each (and I totally recommend doing this because every bit helps!!) 🙂

Other questions… do Selkie ever do sales?

They sure do! Every now and then they will run discounts on their site like on Black Friday or occasional seasonal sales as stock clear outs.

What about any student discounts available with Selkie? Sorry! I don’t think so.

But remember that my Selkie influencer code will ALWAYS be in effect – any time of the year and works with most of the sales they have on.

Enjoy your dress savings!

I hope this blog post was helpful in providing a Selkie discount code for you.

I recognise it’s a lot of information to share a discount code. But in this economy, every bit of savings can count and help. Especially when someone is searching online to add some savings to their shopping cart and hopefully this article can pull up right to the top to help.

Plus when it’s on bucket list designer items, it feels pretty great to save a little bit!

Also, you can almost ALWAYS use my Selkie influencer code when they have a sale on too. That way it can be even more helpful for extra additional savings. Every bit helps in my opinion!

So just like that Selkie and its magical folklore can become a part of your everyday style too. Don’t miss this opportunity to make your wardrobe a canvas for mythical tales and captivating designs.

Happy shopping!!
